title: Fourier weight preservation under the lift
statement: For natural numbers $n,k,q$, a function $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, and a pair $z$ consisting of a tuple of $q$ size-$k$ subsets with empty symmetric difference and a permutation of the $k$ positions in each part, the product of the absolute Fourier coefficients indexed by the labels of the lifted matching equals the product of the absolute Fourier coefficients indexed by the original tuple of subsets.
hypotheses_covered: $z$ is a level-$k$ parity tuple together with a reordering
